command_line:
set -eu
Rscript --vanilla - "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78867858/inputs/dataset_1dd625a3-b9ea-4bc6-b420-7175061e40ac.dat" "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78867858/inputs/dataset_35b40e1a-a815-457e-af97-cd387a73f7f1.dat" "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78867858/inputs/dataset_19d6c629-740f-4bbf-8cce-96ec08fb40c9.dat" <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 3L) stop("Expected counts, gene metadata, and sample annotation inputs")

counts <- read.csv(args[[1]], header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE,
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
meta <- read.csv(args[[2]], header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE,
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
annot <- read.csv(args[[3]], header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE,
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

required_meta <- c("Length", "gene_biotype")
required_annot <- c("sample", "celltype")
if (!all(required_meta %in% names(meta))) stop("Gene metadata lacks required columns")
if (!all(required_annot %in% names(annot))) stop("Sample annotation lacks required columns")
if (ncol(counts) < 2L) stop("Count matrix has no sample columns")

gene_ids <- as.character(counts[[1]])
meta_gene_ids <- as.character(meta[[1]])
if (anyDuplicated(gene_ids)) stop("Duplicate gene IDs in count matrix")
if (anyDuplicated(meta_gene_ids)) stop("Duplicate gene IDs in metadata")
if (anyDuplicated(annot$sample)) stop("Duplicate sample IDs in annotation")

meta_idx <- match(gene_ids, meta_gene_ids)
protein <- !is.na(meta_idx) & meta$gene_biotype[meta_idx] == "protein_coding"
if (!any(protein)) stop("No protein-coding genes matched")
gene_lengths <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(meta$Length[meta_idx[protein]]))
if (any(!is.finite(gene_lengths))) stop("Non-finite protein-coding gene lengths")

cell_types <- c("CD4", "CD8", "CD14", "CD19")
sample_columns <- names(counts)[-1]
rows <- lapply(cell_types, function(ct) {
  selected <- as.character(annot$sample[annot$celltype == ct])
  if (!length(selected)) stop(paste("No annotated samples for", ct))
  missing <- setdiff(selected, sample_columns)
  if (length(missing)) stop(paste("Annotated samples missing from counts for", ct,
                                  paste(missing, collapse = ",")))
  values <- as.matrix(counts[protein, selected, drop = FALSE])
  storage.mode(values) <- "double"
  if (any(!is.finite(values))) stop(paste("Non-finite expression value for", ct))
  mean_expression <- rowMeans(values)
  r <- stats::cor(gene_lengths, mean_expression,
                  method = "pearson", use = "everything")
  data.frame(celltype = ct,
             pearson_r = r,
             absolute_r = abs(r),
             protein_coding_genes = length(gene_lengths),
             samples = length(selected),
             aggregation = "arithmetic_mean_across_annotated_samples",
             method = "Pearson",
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})
result <- do.call(rbind, rows)
write.table(result, file = "correlations.tsv", sep = "	", quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
RSCRIPT
